summary: Fixed schema objects-get returning only the properties array instead of the full collection config.
reason: The generator set responsePath="properties" for GET /schema/{className}, confusing the Class.properties array with the unrelated IndexStatusResponse.properties field used by the sibling /schema/{className}/indexes endpoint. Confirmed live against a real Weaviate Cloud cluster: the raw API returns the full Class object (class, vectorizer, replicationConfig, shardingConfig, properties, etc.), but the generated command discarded everything except properties.
validated_outcome: Confirmed live: `schema objects-get <collection> --json` now returns the full Class object matching the raw API response.
